notes.title: ☄️ Battle Royale Event: Strike 5 Winners 🏆
notes.content:
Greetings, dear players!

[h3]Yet another defeat for Doh![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42514322/f4a7b54d4f18db6d01b08f1e8322dfe7826c27ff.png[/img]

🙏 Thank you all for participating in our [b]Battle Royale Event: Strike 5[/b]. We [b]apologize for the technical issues[/b] with the livestream; we're working on fixing it. We appreciate your [b]patience [/b]and we thank you for sticking with us!

🏆 Now, it is time to announce the winners, congratulations to: [b]olatari[/b], [b]Vieux_Gamer[/b], [b]VanAlphen [/b]and [b]BustaUppa[/b]!

🗓️ Didn't win this time? Don't worry, our [b]next event is in two weeks[/b]! Same day, same time, same place as always.

📬 Stay connected!
